name: pid
description: A unique identifier for each soil sample or observation in the dataset.

name: top
description: The depth of the top boundary of the soil sample, typically measured in centimeters from the soil surface.

name: bot
description: The depth of the bottom boundary of the soil sample, typically measured in centimeters from the soil surface.

name: sand
description: The percentage or weight fraction of sand particles present in the soil sample, indicating the soil texture.

name: bd
description: The bulk density of the soil, usually expressed in grams per cubic centimeter, representing the mass of soil per unit volume.

name: pH
description: The measure of the acidity or alkalinity of the soil, typically on a scale from 0 to 14, where lower values indicate acidity and higher values indicate alkalinity.

name: soc
description: The concentration of soil organic carbon in the soil sample, often expressed in grams of carbon per kilogram of soil.
